column3: a clearly feminine young adult dragonborn: burnished bronze scales, amber eyes, slender swept-back horns, lean athletic build
an androgynous dragonborn: deep sapphire-blue scales fading to pale grey on the throat, short frilled crest, ice-grey eyes, wiry build
a clearly masculine dragonborn: copper-red scales with darker plating on brow and shoulders, broad heavy horns, massive build
an androgynous young adult dwarf: smooth face, ash-blond hair cropped short on the sides and tied back on top, steel-grey eyes, compact sturdy build
a clearly masculine dwarf: weathered face, substantial braided russet beard with simple metal bands, broad chest
a clearly feminine young adult elf: pale skin, long copper-red hair, green eyes, slender build
an androgynous elf: olive skin, short glossy black hair, very slender build
a clearly masculine young adult elf: dark-brown skin, long straight pale-blond hair tied back, narrow youthful face, slender athletic build
a clearly feminine young adult fairy: warm brown skin, dark curly hair with tiny blossoms, iridescent dragonfly wings
an androgynous fairy: pale skin with a faint green tint, tousled short silver-green hair, dusky moth-like wings with soft eye-spots
a clearly masculine fairy: light brown skin, sandy hair, short beard, amber butterfly wings
a clearly feminine young adult gnome: wild orange curls, freckles, big hazel eyes
an androgynous gnome: lilac-tinted short hair, round spectacles, light tan skin
a clearly masculine young adult gnome: tousled chestnut hair, clean-shaven or very short neat chin beard, rosy cheeks, bright eyes
a clearly feminine young adult goliath: light stone-grey skin with darker slate lichen-like markings across face and arms, a long thick dark braid, feminine face and figure
an androgynous goliath: blue-grey skin with white frost-like markings, long black topknot
a clearly masculine young adult goliath: stony grey skin with dark lichen-like markings, strong youthful jaw, no beard, short black hair
a clearly feminine young adult halfling: chestnut curls, rosy cheeks, brown eyes
an androgynous ADULT halfling (an adult of a small people, NOT a child — adult facial structure and proportions): tawny short hair, freckles, light brown skin
a clearly masculine halfling: sandy curly hair, round face with sideburns
a clearly feminine young adult human: dark-brown skin, short natural black hair, strong jaw
an androgynous human: light-olive skin, straight chin-length black hair, sharp features
a clearly masculine human: fair weathered skin, auburn hair with stubble
a clearly feminine young adult orc: grey-green skin, long black braids, small tusks, amber eyes
an androgynous orc: ash-grey skin, shaved head with a healed scar, medium tusks
a clearly masculine young adult orc: dark olive-green skin, long black hair, prominent lower tusks, strong youthful face
a clearly feminine young adult tiefling: crimson skin, curled ram horns, long black hair, solid golden eyes, a long tail
an androgynous tiefling: lavender-grey skin, straight swept-back horns, short white hair, solid silver eyes, a long tail
a clearly masculine tiefling: deep plum skin, thick curled horns, swept-back black hair, short black beard, solid red eyes, a long tail
a clearly feminine dwarf: ruddy freckled face, broad rounded nose, warm brown eyes, thick auburn hair in two heavy braids with plain copper bands, no beard
